limits: Startup has a 30-second total deadline from process launch; measurement/control phase has a configurable 75-second wall-clock deadline (58 seconds by default).
F4 frame_history_ms samples are DebugClock app-loop start-to-start intervals. FPS equivalents are reciprocal interval summaries, not probe or script throughput.

F4 JSON/PNG export occurs at stage boundaries. A report-triggered/export-cost frame can be recorded on either side of a snapshot and contaminate a stage boundary sample; boundary effects are not removed.

The F4 schema exports history_samples as current ring size, not a monotonic sequence. Per-stage samples use a count delta only while the after snapshot remains below configured capacity; common-value overlap after the ring is full is approximate.
The hidden, disabled window receives only posted messages addressed to its own process window. No SendKeys or global desktop input is used.
Movement and turning are representative input activity only; exact path depends on caller-selected content/map/profile and current controls.

Live encounter counters are the authored workload actually reached during the bounded capture; RequiredLivingZombies=60 is checked against the final F4 alive count, not a peak count. This is not a GPU profile, benchmark acceptance or human playtest.
